definitionZh: 文本间距-trim CSS属性控制了中/日/韩(CJK) punctuation字符在相邻字符(kerning)之间以及文本行开头或结尾处的内部间隔.
sourceDefinition: The text-spacing-trim CSS property controls the internal spacing set on Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) punctuation characters between adjacent characters (kerning) and at the start or end of text lines.
